notes: Original experimental study: H2 uptake of KOH-activated bamboo carbons AC2-AC6 and bamboo charcoal BC measured at 77 K, up to 1 bar (ASAP 2020 HD88) and up to 8 MPa (HPVA-100), with Maxsorb-3 compared. Surface areas by BET from N2 at 77 K for every sample. Not a review; is_retracted false and no retraction statement in the text; no statement that the uptake values were published before (an earlier related paper is cited only as background), so duplicate_data does not apply. No supplementary files supplied. The paper calls the HPVA-100 a gravimetric analyzer; either way I1 is met (gravimetric or volumetric).
